method_wheel: tools/wheel/: each set = one nano-banana-2 2K edit of a 1280 x 720 crop of hero-HW-fix1.png (sent x2), registered (SIFT affine, prep.py) and tone-fitted; the pieces' masks from grok segment-map (0 tokens); alpha as stage A (4 px fringe of the edit's room, anti-aliased against another product, 4 px on under the table); the set's pixels = the edit baked with the stage-A finish, the lamps' screen solved out and the higher layers' (the table's) shadow divided out; its shadow = low-pass luma(edit) / luma(the stack without the cushions), darker only, in a 90 px zone of influence (stage A's radius); one recorded refit (the left cushion to 45/50)
method_pecan: tools/pecan/: one nano-banana-2 2K edit of the wheel's crop of hero-HW-fix1.png (the same upload), the throw only; registered (SIFT affine, prep.py) and tone-fitted; masks from grok segment-map (0 tokens). Cut as tools/wheel/w7build.py, but only inside Z = (old throw | new throw, 6 px) minus the cushions: there the edit's alpha (4 px fringe of the room, anti-aliased against another product, 4 px on under the table) and pixels (the stage-A finish baked, the lamps' screen solved out, the table's shadow divided out); elsewhere set-B.png byte for byte. The shadow: set B's beyond 90 px of the throw, the new low-pass luma ratio within 45 px, a log blend between, set B's under the cushions. One patch: the lamp's pole where the knit hid it
